PrepChecklist.Name: Logo image
PrepChecklist.Needed: Upload pharmacy/clinic logo used for tray icon and Doctor Contacts.

PrepChecklist.Name: QR website
PrepChecklist.Needed: Paste website URL for Doctor Contacts QR code.

PrepChecklist.Name: Address
PrepChecklist.Needed: Set multiline address, including skipped lines if needed.

PrepChecklist.Name: DDA details and medicine search
PrepChecklist.Needed: Review reusable DDA Details text; medicine names build automatically from the DDA HUD tool.

PrepChecklist.Name: Custom TxT/PDF
PrepChecklist.Needed: Choose default custom text or PDF file.

PrepChecklist.Name: Order CSV
PrepChecklist.Needed: Choose product reference CSV with Product NAME, WHS, RRP, %.

PrepChecklist.Name: Remedy Recipes API
PrepChecklist.Needed: Optional: set an OpenAI-compatible recipe API endpoint/model, or leave blank for offline safe recipes.

PrepChecklist.Name: Thermal test print
PrepChecklist.Needed: Enable Superuser Mode and run a test print on the target printer.
